title: Cited finished report row
description: One scanned practice. mentionedInstead and sources.names may only contain names that actually appeared. Never invent names.

business.description: Practice name as queued or scanned. Do not invent a different name.

mentioned.description: True only if a source name fuzzy-matches business.

queries.description: Patient questions that were actually run.

mentionedInstead.description: Unique other practice names that actually appeared. Empty if none appeared.

engine.description: perplexity, chatgpt, or gemini — whichever actually produced the names.

names.description: Practice-like names shown for this query. Empty array if none were shown. Never invent.

whatThisMeans.description: Optional honest note. Omit to let the report page write one.
